details.completeness_justification: K1–K5 and K7 are fully covered. K6 is only partially covered (regional split shown but segment/product breakdown and export percentages omitted). K8 is entirely missing (no mention of the Board’s proposal to cover the loss from retained earnings).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: revenue changes are explained by region, profitability improvements are directly linked to cost reductions, and cash-flow gains are presented as a consequence of the narrowed operating loss. No sentence contradicts another, and the narrative flows from performance overview through profitability, cash generation, and forward-looking commentary without repetition or structural gaps.
